topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: I can hardly believe it! After all these months of chatting with Sam online, it turns out we're neighbors in the same city. I remember the moment they mentioned a local landmark in passing, and I paused, the pieces clicking into place. I asked, tentatively, and there it was—a coincidence that feels almost too perfect. We've already made plans to meet up for coffee this weekend. It's exciting to think about putting a face to the name, to finally shift our friendship from digital to real life. This opens up so many possibilities for our friendship; I can't wait to see where this goes.
